Follow docs/INSTALLATION.md in that archive, keeping the wheel next to it and using the explicit parent-directory wheel path after extraction.
Follow docs/POWERPOINT.md to create the supplied sample with the installed interpreter, convert with notes included and excluded, and verify four source slides.
Compare the deck and mirror for slide order, labelled note association and readability.
